meta.name: airflow-dag-patterns
meta.description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级的数据管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据工程师,用 Airflow 编排任务,想写出更规范的 DAG。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage data pipelines and want reliable, maintainable DAGs.

howto.what: 它会帮你写生产用的 Airflow DAG：设计任务依赖、配置重试与超时、实现 operator 与 sensor，并给出本地测试和上线部署的做法。
howto.when: 当你要建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批量任务时接管；设计 DAG 结构、调试失败任务等场合也适用。

say.text: 我的 DAG 跑失败了，帮我看看重试和超时该怎么配？
say.note: 会检查 retries、timeout 等设置。

howto.what_en: It writes production Airflow DAGs: task dependencies, retries and timeouts, custom operators and sensors, plus local testing and deployment setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, or schedule batch jobs; also when designing DAG structures or debugging failed runs.

say_en.text: Write a daily 6 AM ETL DAG using PythonOperator for extract and load.
say_en.note: Produces DAG code with default args and dependencies.

say_en.text: My sensor keeps holding workers - how do I switch it to reschedule mode?
My DAG run failed; help me set up retries and timeouts.
say_en.note: Reviews retries, timeout, and backoff settings.
